title: Hughes Aircraft builds the Glomar Explorer for subsea recovery
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Hughes Aircraft builds the Glomar Explorer for subsea recovery, about 1970s at ocean, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: you have things like you know, Hughes Aircraft building the Glomar Explorer

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to the Glomar Explorer, a ship built for recovering things from the deep ocean floor, which he says was built by Hughes Aircraft, an American aerospace company, in the 1970s. He brings it up as an example of a private company quietly building secret machines for the government, the kind of arrangement that would matter if recovered UFOs were being handled the same way.
